candidates.description: Replace the record‑based DTO projection with a Spring Data interface projection to avoid constructing DTO objects for each row. Define an interface CustomerBioView with getId(), getCustomerName(), getBio() and let the repository return List<CustomerBioView>. Service maps these directly to the existing record, eliminating per‑row object allocation.
candidates.predicted_effect: allocations drop from ~N objects to ~N/2 objects per request
what_could_break: If other parts of the code rely on the concrete CustomerBioDto type returned from the repository, the interface projection may cause ClassCastException.
